Metode

blocks.text: Group A received 10 mg, whereas group B received 20 mg. The effect was not statistically significant (p = 0.08).

blocks.target: Grup A diterima 10 mg, dimana grup B menerima 20 mg. Efeknya bukan signifikan secara statistik (p = 0.08).
Matematika

blocks.text: Given f(x)=x², the derivative is f′(x)=2x.
sourceLines: Given f(x)=x², the derivative is f′(x)=2x.

blocks.text: The estimator is unbiased only if both conditions hold.

Kesimpulan

blocks.text: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
